intro.title: Introduction to USize
intro.lead: USize is a SaaS that allows any fashion store to add an intelligent size prediction widget trained on their brand's specific data.
intro.howDesc: The architecture is based on TensorFlow.js, which allows the neural network model to be trained and run directly in the user's browser. This guarantees maximum privacy since no personal data ever leaves the device.
steps: The merchant uploads their size data through the dashboard.
The model trains in the browser in seconds.
A unique integration snippet is generated with your API key.
Your store visitors get personalized size predictions.

intro.callout: The network architecture is: 4 → 100 → 1000 → 100 → 6 (softmax). Trained with Adam optimizer and categorical crossentropy.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Answers to the most common questions about USize.
faq.a1: Once the model is trained and saved in the browser's localStorage, predictions work completely offline.
faq.a2: USize supports Chrome 80+, Firefox 78+, Safari 14+, Edge 80+. Internet Explorer is not supported.
faq.q3: Can I use sizes beyond XS–XXL?
faq.a3: The model natively supports XS, S, M, L, XL and XXL. Support for numeric sizes (28, 30, 32…) or 3XL and above is planned for a future version.
faq.q4: How do I know if my model has good accuracy?
faq.a4: In the dashboard you can see the accuracy metric from the last training. A value above 90% indicates a good model. If it's lower, add more training data.
faq.a5: Yes. The model trains and runs in the user's browser. No personal measurements are sent to any external server. Your API key is only used to validate your subscription.
faq.callout: Have a question that's not here? Write to us at <mail>support@usize.app</mail>.
